import json
T=G['Test input']
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    seed=[v for v in cnt if v not in (0,1) and v!=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]]
    # seed = minority color; here 7
    col=min((v for v in cnt if v not in (0,cnt.most_common(1)[0][0])), key=lambda v:cnt[v]) if seed else None
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==col]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for dr in range(-H,H):
        for dc in range(-W,W):
            if all(0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W and g[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for r,c in cells):
                for r,c in cells:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc]=col
    return out
O=transform(T)
print([(r,c) for r in range(len(T)) for c in range(len(T[0])) if O[r][c]!=T[r][c]])
